test_title: PYST 28: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 17 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Nick, Kevin, and Joe can finish a certain piece of work in 3, 9, and 27 days respectively. All three of them started the work together. Nick left after working for 1 day, and Kevin left 2 days before the work was completed. Find the total number of days taken to complete the work.
solution:
**Given:**

Times: Nick = 3 days, Kevin = 9 days, Joe = 27 days

Nick left after 1 day; Kevin left 2 days before completion

**Calculations:**

⇒ LCM(3,9,27) = 27 (Total work)

⇒ Efficiency: Nick = 27 ÷ 3 = 9 units/day, Kevin = 27 ÷ 9 = 3 units/day, Joe = 27 ÷ 27 = 1 unit/day
